info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Management Product Training-spec
info.description: The Product Training Management API enables organizations to effectively manage and streamline the training process for their product offerings. By utilizing this API, businesses can create and maintain training specifications, ensuring that their teams are well-equipped to support product initiatives. Typical consumers of this API include product managers, training coordinators, and business analysts who rely on structured training data for product development and employee onboarding. This API empowers companies to enhance product knowledge and improve overall performance through well-defined training resources.
